title: Governance of sustainability matters
description: Describe the role of administrative, management and supervisory bodies with regard to sustainability matters and how responsibility is allocated.
input_guidance: Describe board-level sustainability roles, oversight frequency, sustainability committee if any, and how sustainability is integrated into remuneration.

title: Strategy, business model and value chain
description: Describe the company's strategy, business model, and value chain with respect to sustainability impacts, risks, and opportunities.
input_guidance: Describe your main products/services, geographies, value chain (upstream suppliers, downstream customers), and how sustainability is integrated into the business model.

title: Impact, risk and opportunity identification (Double Materiality)
description: Describe the process used to identify impacts, risks, and opportunities (IROs) and assess their materiality using double materiality methodology.
input_guidance: Describe stakeholder engagement process, how you identified material topics, thresholds used for materiality decisions, and list of material topics selected.

title: Climate transition plan and alignment with Paris Agreement
description: Describe the company's transition plan for climate change mitigation and how it aligns with limiting global warming to 1.5°C.
input_guidance: Describe your net-zero targets, interim milestones, planned capital expenditure, technology pathways, and how you track progress against the plan.

title: Energy consumption and mix
description: Total energy consumption in MWh, broken down by fossil and renewable sources. Includes electricity, heat, steam, and cooling.
input_guidance: Upload electricity invoices, gas invoices, and any renewable energy certificates (EACs/RECs/PPAs). Or enter total kWh directly with supporting documentation.

title: GHG emissions (Scope 1, 2 and material Scope 3)
description: Total gross GHG emissions in tCO2e for Scope 1 (direct), Scope 2 (purchased energy), and material Scope 3 categories.
input_guidance: Upload utility invoices for Scope 2. For Scope 1, upload fuel invoices or enter vehicle/facility consumption. Scope 3 requires supply chain data collection.

title: GHG removals and carbon credits
description: GHG removals from the atmosphere and any carbon credits purchased or cancelled.
input_guidance: Only required if you use carbon credits or have nature-based removal projects. Enter total tonnes removed and source (e.g. Gold Standard offset registry).

title: Anticipated financial effects from climate-related risks
description: Quantification of anticipated financial effects from material physical and transition climate risks and opportunities.
input_guidance: Describe top 3-5 physical and transition risks, your scenario analysis (1.5°C / 4°C), and estimated financial impact range where possible.

title: Pollution of air, water and soil
description: Emissions of pollutants to air, water, and soil from operations and products.
input_guidance: Required if pollution is identified as a material topic. Enter NOx, SOx, PM2.5, VOC emissions. Upload environmental permits or annual environmental reports.

title: Water consumption
description: Total water consumption in m3, with breakdown by water-stressed areas.
input_guidance: Upload water utility invoices or meter readings. Identify which facilities are in water-stressed areas using WRI Aqueduct tool.

title: Waste
description: Total waste generated in tonnes, broken down by hazardous/non-hazardous and disposal method (landfill, incineration, recycling, recovery).
input_guidance: Upload waste manifests, contractor disposal records, or annual waste audits. Or enter total waste tonnes per disposal route.

title: Workforce characteristics and headcount
description: Total headcount, breakdown by gender, employment type (full-time/part-time), region, and employment relationship (employees vs contractors).
input_guidance: Upload HR system headcount export or payroll summary. Enter total FTE, % female employees, % part-time, headcount by country.

title: Diversity metrics (gender, age, disability)
description: Gender distribution at board level and across management layers. Age distribution. Disability inclusion.
input_guidance: Enter % female in top management, % female on board, age brackets (under 30 / 30-50 / 50+). Upload diversity policy if available.

title: Remuneration metrics (CEO pay ratio, gender pay gap)
description: CEO pay ratio (CEO total compensation vs. median employee), and unadjusted gender pay gap.
input_guidance: Enter CEO total annual compensation, median employee annual compensation, and female vs. male median base salary. Upload payroll analysis if available.

title: Health and safety metrics
description: Work-related injuries (TRIR), fatalities, recordable work-related ill health cases, and number of days lost.
input_guidance: Upload OSHA/RIDDOR incident logs or annual safety reports. Enter total recordable incidents, near-misses, lost time injuries.

title: Policies for own workforce (employment and labour practices)
description: Policies on working conditions, equal treatment, human rights, and trade union rights for own workforce.
input_guidance: Describe your employment policies: working hours policy, non-discrimination policy, freedom of association stance, grievance mechanism. Upload policy documents.

title: Policies and due diligence for value chain workers
description: Human rights due diligence process for workers in the upstream and downstream value chain.
input_guidance: Required if value chain workers are a material topic. Describe supplier code of conduct, audit programme, grievance channels for supply chain workers.

title: Corporate culture and business conduct policies
description: Policies on anti-corruption, anti-bribery, fair competition, and corporate culture.
input_guidance: Upload your code of conduct, anti-bribery and anti-corruption policy, whistleblower policy. Describe training coverage % for employees.

title: Prevention and detection of corruption and bribery
description: Number of confirmed corruption or bribery incidents and fines. Whistleblower channel existence and usage.
input_guidance: Enter: number of confirmed corruption incidents in the reporting year (if any), total fines paid, % of employees trained on anti-corruption.

title: Payment practices (SME payment terms)
description: Average payment period to suppliers, particularly SME suppliers. Number of legal proceedings for late payment.
input_guidance: Enter average days to pay supplier invoices. Note any legal disputes over late payment. This data is often available from accounts payable.
